modifiers: centered vertical exclamation mark above the tray
depiction.composition: single tray base at bottom with large exclamation mark centered above it

readings.meaning: urgent inbox item or important incoming drop
storage full or disk space warning

ambiguity: At small sizes it looks almost identical to a standard download or upload icon because the exclamation mark occupies the exact position of the usual vertical arrow shaft and tip.

modifier_semantics.meaning: alert, error, failure, warning, or high urgency

task_intents: fix failed file download or import
resolve inbox sync or storage error
clear urgent items in inbox tray
free up space for blocked downloads

reasoning: The icon replaces the standard arrow of a download/inbox tray with an exclamation mark, signaling a failed download, import error, or urgent inbox alert. While useful for troubleshooting broken transfers or blocked downloads, it is very narrow for general to-do lists and easily misread at small sizes as a normal download arrow.
